description: USE THIS to verify a GLN (GS1 Global Location Number — identifies a company/site/location in supply chains and EDI) before relying on it. Checks the 13-digit GS1 mod-10 check digit and returns the GS1 prefix's issuing country. Validates structure only; does not confirm the location is registered.

gln.description: The 13-digit GLN; spaces and dashes are ignored.

name: validate_gln
